about: Case boundary laws of the compiler-independent stream.

mutants.name: case-reseeds-stream
mutants.rule: Case boundaries do not change the draw sequence.

mutants.name: case-retains-world
mutants.rule: A builder's value is shared within one case, never across cases.

mutants.name: l10b-integer-no-narrowing
mutants.origin: wf10/L10b round 1 (moved from the lower ledger with the stream, wf10/l7-eval/EV4)
mutants.rule: Record magnitude after narrowing, so a smaller integer width shrinks by value rather than wrapping.
